summary: ArcelorMittal filed Form 424B5 for a $1 billion offering of 5.375% notes due 2036. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations, redeemable at make-whole or par price, and subject to change-of-control puts at 101%. Joint book-runners are BofA, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, HSBC, J.P. Morgan, Santander, Standard Chartered. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The notes will not be listed on any exchange. There is no extraordinary corporate action; the filing is a standard takedown from an existing shelf registration.
